overview: The Council approved a new standard compensation ordinance for contracted services and updated several personnel classifications. The body also conducted extensive discussions on the fiscal year 2027 budget, ultimately tabling it along with several financial appropriations pending further legal expenditure data.

items.title: Approval of Records and Committee Reports
items.summary: Approved meeting records from May and June 2026 and reports from the Committee of the Whole regarding fiscal year 2027 budget hearings.

items.title: Standard Compensation Ordinance
items.summary: Approved the third reading of an ordinance establishing a wage floor and benefits for contracted janitorial and security services despite administrative requests for further delay. Supporters emphasized the need for worker stability and living wages while the administration cited concerns regarding legal terminology and liability.

items.title: Personnel Ordinance Amendments for Department Heads
items.summary: Approved the third reading of classification changes for the Director of Elections, Director of Diversity, Equity and Inclusion, and Director of Veteran Services. The Council maintained its previous decision to place all three positions in the same compensation tier based on a third-party study, rejecting administrative concerns regarding internal equity and tenure.

items.title: Grant of Location: National Grid
items.summary: Approved a petition by National Grid to install an underground electric conduit between 3960 and 4000 Mystic Valley Parkway subject to engineering conditions.

items.title: Coldstone Creamery Extended Hours
items.summary: Approved extending summer operating hours for Scoopology LLC until 1:00 a.m. daily, with a 21-day review period to monitor community impacts.

items.title: MBTA Bus Network Redesign Resolution
items.summary: Approved a resolution to conduct public outreach and solicit feedback on MBTA proposals for modifying bus routes 80, 94, and 96.

items.title: Affordable Housing Trust Fund Board Reappointment
items.summary: Approved the reappointment of Lisa Ann Davidson as chair of the Affordable Housing Trust Fund Board.

items.title: Medford Square Fest Food Truck Permits
items.summary: Approved the permit for June 13, 2026, but tabled permits for later dates to facilitate further discussion regarding impacts on brick-and-mortar restaurants.

items.title: Water and Sewer Enterprise Fund Retained Earnings
items.summary: Approved the appropriation of $5.5 million for the design and construction of water main replacements on several city streets. The City Engineer noted this work addresses low-pressure zones and precedes upcoming paving projects.

items.title: Schools Special Purpose Override Stabilization Fund
items.summary: Approved an appropriation of approximately $1.1 million to support teacher contracts, athletic stipends, and enhanced extracurricular programming at Medford Public Schools.

items.title: PEG Access and Cable Related Special Revenue Fund
items.summary: Voted to establish a special revenue fund to reserve cable franchise fees for PEG access services and oversight starting in fiscal year 2027.

items.title: Fiscal Year 2027 General Fund and Enterprise Budgets
items.summary: Tabled the $217 million general fund budget and several free cash appropriations until June 23, 2026. Councilors requested more comprehensive data on legal expenditures and questioned the administration's proposal to tie funding for various city priorities to the preservation of the law department budget.
